parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The time is in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format and in UTC.

parameters.name: MixStreamId
parameters.description: The ID of the stream mixing task. If you create a stream mixing task by calling the [CreateMixStream](~~2848087~~) operation, use the MixStreamId value that is returned in the response.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be greater than **0** and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records to display on each page. Default value: **1000**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. The time is in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format and in UTC.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The stream name of the stream mixing task.
